Policies and Initiatives.title: Union Budget 2026: Seven new rail corridors announced
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Union Budget 2026 has announced seven new rail corridors, dubbed "growth connectors", spanning 4,000 km. These corridors will connect major cities, including Mumbai-Pune, Pune-Hyderabad, and Delhi-Varanasi, among others. The infrastructure project is estimated to cost ₹16 lakh crore.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Budget 2026: Mamata Banerjee slams allocation, moves SC against EC, CEO over SIR
Policies and Initiatives.summary: West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee has approached the Supreme Court against the Election Commission and the state's chief electoral officer over the Special Intensive Revision of the electoral roll. Banerjee alleges that the BJP is using the process to manipulate voters ahead of upcoming elections. She also claims that the process has caused stress-related deaths among citizens.

Policies and Initiatives.title: CM Mamata Banerjee slams Union Budget as ‘garbage of lies’, says Bengal gets nothing
Policies and Initiatives.summary: West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee criticized the Union Budget, calling it a "garbage of lies" and stating that the state received no benefits. She noted declines in education and social security funds, with Trinamool leaders suggesting the budget intentionally neglected the state due to upcoming elections. The budget was dubbed a "Humpty Dumpty Budget" by Banerjee, implying it was poorly constructed and ineffective.

Policies and Initiatives.title: 'It's a Humpty-Dumpty budget': Ahead assembly polls, CM Mamata Banerjee slams Union Budget 2026–27
Policies and Initiatives.summary: West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee criticized the Union Budget 2026-27, calling it "anti-women, anti-farmer, anti-education" and stating it lacks benefits for Bengal. Her comments came after Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman's budget presentation, which included proposals for an East Coast Industrial Corridor and tourism development in eastern states. The criticism comes ahead of the upcoming assembly polls in the state.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Union Budget 2026 falls short of expectations in poll-bound West Bengal
Policies and Initiatives.summary: West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee expressed disappointment with the Union Budget 2026, stating it offers nothing to the state's people. In contrast, the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) leadership believes the budget's infrastructure push will boost the state's economy. The differing opinions come ahead of upcoming polls in West Bengal.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Watch: Union Budget proposals spark political debate ahead of West Bengal polls
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Union Budget's infrastructure proposals have sparked a political debate in West Bengal ahead of the Assembly elections. The BJP is highlighting the development potential of the proposals, while the TMC is criticizing them as political signalling. The debate centers around freight and industrial corridors, as well as tourism projects.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Union Budget turns election spotlight on West Bengal with freight corridors, industry push
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Union Budget has shifted focus to West Bengal ahead of its Assembly elections, with allocations for freight corridors and industry development. This move is seen as a strategic attempt to influence the election outcome, following a pattern of previous budgets that emphasized regional development before state elections. The budget's regional emphasis is expected to impact the state's economic and industrial growth.
